title: General Knowledge (Demo)
description: Dummy questions to test the app.

questions.question: Which of these are planets in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet in 2006. The Moon is Earth's satellite.

questions.question: What is the capital of Germany?
Which of these numbers are prime?
questions.explanation: All of them! Sometimes every answer is correct.

questions.question: Water boils at 100 °C at sea level.
Which of these are mammals?
questions.explanation: Dolphins and bats are mammals; sharks are fish.
